title: FDA Approves First Treatment for Limb-Girdle Muscular Dystrophy Type 2I/R9 | FDA
summary:
For Immediate Release:
: November 23, 2026

The U.S. Food and Drug Administration today approved Welgemda (ribitol), the first medicine for treating limb-girdle muscular dystrophy type 2I/R9 (LGMD2I/R9), a rare inherited muscle disease, for adults and pediatric patients weighing at least 30 kg. Welgemda is the first therapy approved for any form of limb-girdle muscular dystrophy.

summary:

It is approved in adults and paediatric patients weighing at least 15kg.
